decisions.reason: Turnaround management software has its own page, sits close to the core offer and is central to the announced data-driven airport direction, so the firm's visible investment and commitment keep it firmly on the market.
The apron connectivity module underpins the integrated digital platform, and slow uptake can still be blamed on long airport procurement cycles, so management persists with it.
Billing software is less central to airside operations and only mentioned on the website, but it builds on the established offer and is still young, so the firm keeps it while watching its uptake.
Equipment monitoring draws on the installed base and supports the announced expansion into lifecycle services, so it fits the strategy and stays.
Apron resource management is close to the core offer and integral to the end-to-end operations suite, so sunk investment and strategic fit favour keeping it.
